data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'alos' meaning 'noble' or 'exalted' and the suffix 'dee' meaning 'one'. In Greek mythology, Alos was the goddess of kindness and hospitality. The name Alodee carries the meaning “Exalted one” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Alodee usually hope their child will grow to embody exalted one and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Alodee total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
